info.name: Sprint I — Christophe ElChabab services
info.description: Run folders in order against your own system. Fill administrator credentials and newUserPassword locally. Setup creates role accounts and an asset through Joey APIs. Threats/vulnerabilities/incidents are Christophe ElChabab routes; integration calls verify Karl/Joey services. No saved response is fabricated. Capture actual screenshots before Cleanup.
